goal: Cut GitHub request traffic without slowing work (#2773 part C): the idempotent reviewer assignment retry and both silent-reclaim routes use at most 10 API requests with no explicit quota call, proven by the wire fixture.
dispatcher: Claude coordinator session relaying Albert's #2773 instruction
prohibited_actions: No database write or structure change of any kind
No weakening of collision locks, migration version reservation or serial lanes
assumptions: The in-mutex fresh PR read and activity re-proof stay REST/GraphQL as before; only the pre-mutex PR read is folded into one GraphQL request
stop_conditions: Stop if any change makes an unreadable ref or commit read as absent, or weakens a safety lock
